scope: Four new original primary PDFs, exact snapshots pinned. Archived pages are not pages fully read. These papers establish background geometry/monodromy, not a new special-value irrationality theorem.

papers.title: Differential equations, mirror maps and zeta values
papers.actual_read_scope: Abstract and introductory scope; fourth/fifth order exterior-square formulas and CY constraints. The project's complete companion derivation is independently certified rather than copied from a displayed identity.
papers.not_claimed: Full paper audit, new geometric theorem, or a numerical zeta irrationality result.

papers.title: Calabi-Yau differential equations of degree 2 and 3 and Yifan Yang's pullback
papers.actual_read_scope: Fourth/fifth-order CY conditions, exterior-square and pullback formulas, introductory explicit examples. No full catalogue scan is claimed.

papers.title: Monodromy for the hypergeometric function nF(n-1)
papers.version: Inventiones mathematicae 95 (1989), 325-354; original article PDF downloaded 2026-10-06
papers.actual_read_scope: Definitions and local monodromy; Propositions 2.10, 3.2, 3.3 and Theorem 3.5 (Levelt), companion matrices (3.9). Project Sp4 density is separately established by exact Lie algebra closure, not an unread classification theorem.

papers.title: D-brane masses at special fibres of hypergeometric families of Calabi-Yau threefolds, modular forms, and periods
papers.version: Author-hosted BONN-TH-2022-07 snapshot downloaded 2026-10-06; exact PDF pinned without identifying it with another revision
papers.actual_visual_check: PDF7 Table 1 rendered with Poppler and actually viewed; first row is half parameters, 1/mu=2^8=256, mirror four quadrics. Render is research/cdt_odd_spin_primary_table_20261006.png.
papers.actual_read_scope: Title/abstract; Section 2.1 and Table 1 half-parameter four-quadrics operator, Section 2.4.2 explicit quotient/resolution and coordinate z=1/(2psi)^8, and Section 4 introduction for conifold Kuga-Sato correspondence. Complete Section 4 and integral period comparison have not been audited.
